scope: Independent source and executable-rule audit; three candidate files only. No checkout modifications or publication.

findings.source_location: NCCP all p1 eligibility; 00373 p2 exclusions
findings.baseline_problem: Generic ECOG>=3 rule applied to all three; 00373 actually restricts ECOG0–1. Most source exclusions/cautions lacked fields.
findings.proposed_resolution: Keep monotherapy0–2 and combination0–1 separate; add adult indication, hypersensitivity, prior BRAF failure versus intolerance, source-specific electrolytes/HTN/QT/concurrent anticancer exclusions.

findings.source_location: NCCP all p3 renal/hepatic tables
findings.baseline_problem: No executable renal/hepatic categories; generic unrelated CK/LVEF holds were shared.
findings.proposed_resolution: CrCl>=30 no adjustment; <30/dialysis none expected, with clinical review. Dabrafenib moderate/severe liver: 50% MAY be considered; vemu severe: no adjustment expected but liver biochemistry twice weekly. Cobi no hepatic adjustment. Do not output calculated prescription.

findings.source_location: NCCP00102 p3 Table1 /00373 p4 Table3
findings.baseline_problem: Only current grade>=3 hold; no intolerable grade2, recurrence, minimum dose, recovered permanent-stop history.
findings.proposed_resolution: Add grade2 tolerability, first/second/third recurrence, first-grade4 consultant choice versus recurrent-grade4 stop, previous480mg floor. In combination00373 Table1 further reduction after480 mandates permanent vemu stop; monotherapy below480 is not recommended and needs consultant disposition. Retain highest event grade after recovery.

findings.source_location: NCCP00237 pp2–3 Tables1/3
findings.baseline_problem: No dose levels or grade4 choice; generic severe toxicity rule discarded dose history.
findings.proposed_resolution: 150/100/75/50mg BID references; grade2 intolerable/grade3 interrupt until0–1 then one level down; grade4 consultant chooses stop OR interrupt/reduce. Re-escalation can be considered after control; max150/min50. Do not import vemu mandatory recurrence rules.

findings.source_location: NCCP00102 p4 Table3 /00373 p8 Table6
findings.baseline_problem: Generic QT>500 whole-regimen hold omitted baseline distinction, delta, recurrence and permanent cessation.
findings.proposed_resolution: Separate baseline >500 not-recommended; on-treatment >500 and >60ms change permanent stop; first/second/third history for <60ms; recovery strictly<500. In combination, vemurafenib only. Historical stop persists after current QT normalises.

findings.source_location: Same NCCP QT tables; printed <60 and >60 criteria
findings.baseline_problem: Exactly60ms boundary has no printed row.
findings.proposed_resolution: Explicit source gap; keep vemu withheld and require clinician/pharmacy interpretation. Do not silently convert <60 to <=60.

findings.source_location: NCCP00237 pp2/4 vs EMA Tafinlar pp4/9 §§4.2/4.4
findings.baseline_problem: Legacy>=38 hold had no source reconciliation; reading NCCP alone would incorrectly regress38–38.49 to no hold.
findings.proposed_resolution: Current EMA explicitly says monotherapy>=38; preserve hold38–38.49 with discrepancy label. NCCP>=38.5 separately documented. At least24h symptom-free before restart; recurrent first-symptom interruption and severe/recurrent reduced-dose review.

findings.source_location: NCCP00237 p2 uveitis; p4 creatinine/pancreatitis
findings.baseline_problem: Generic new-eye-symptom whole-regimen hold disregarded local-treatment control; creatinine/pancreatitis missing.
findings.proposed_resolution: Prompt eye assessment; controlled uveitis no dose change; uncontrolled withhold until resolved then reduce one level. Creatinine>1.5ULN caution, rising creatinine review, abdominal pain prompt amylase/lipase workup.

findings.source_location: NCCP00373 p1 baseline eligibility; p5 Table4
findings.baseline_problem: Blanket LVEF<=50 whole-regimen hold conflated baseline and on-treatment thresholds.
findings.proposed_resolution: Baseline must>50; on-treatment asymptomatic40–49 with<10-point fall does not mandate interruption. Hold cobi for<40 or40–49 with>=10-point fall; symptomatic separate. Retain historical symptoms,2/4-week recovery and third-event stop.

findings.source_location: NCCP00373 p5 Table4, rendered image inspected
findings.baseline_problem: Printed restart <10-point fall overlaps permanent-stop LVEF<40 row in unusual inputs; baseline eligibility may already exclude such baseline.
findings.proposed_resolution: Flag overlapping source criteria, keep withheld, no numerical restart. Confirm actual baseline and specialist interpretation.

findings.source_location: NCCP00373 p6 Table5; monotherapy source tables do not support shared CK5 rule
findings.baseline_problem: CK>=5ULN universal whole-regimen hold on all three.
findings.proposed_resolution: Remove unsupported universal numerical cutoff. Combination: asymptomatic grade<=3 and rhabdo excluded no change; symptomatic/rhabdo or asymptomaticgrade4 hold COBI. Separate 4-week recovery/stop; retain episode symptoms and missed recovery deadline despite subsequent resolution.

findings.source_location: NCCP00373 p6 Table5 haemorrhage
findings.baseline_problem: Generic severe-haemorrhage whole-regimen hold omitted attribution/permanent stop.
findings.proposed_resolution: Grade3 hold cobi during assessment; grade4/cerebral hold then permanently stop if attributed to cobi; vemu may continue. Retain recovered grade4 event history.

findings.source_location: NCCP00373 p7 Table5 liver abnormalities
findings.baseline_problem: No component-specific liver-grade recovery/recurrence pathway.
findings.proposed_resolution: G1–2 monitor; G3 hold VEMU only, restart one level lower after<=1. G4 hold BOTH, within4-week<=1 recovery: cobi one level/vemu two levels lower. Failure to recover within4weeks or recurrentG4 discontinue both; late recovery must not clear prior stop.

findings.source_location: NCCP00373 p7 Table5 skin/diarrhoea
findings.baseline_problem: Generic severe-toxicity rule could not distinguish component exceptions.
findings.proposed_resolution: Photosensitivity holds both but cobi can restart unchanged; acneiform rash cobi pathway, non-acneiform vemu pathway; grade>=3 diarrhoea despite support holds both and recurrence requires both reductions.

findings.source_location: NCCP00373 p4 Table3; EMA Cotellic p7§4.4
findings.baseline_problem: Generic dose logic did not distinguish cobi third-occurrence CONSIDER stop from vemu mandated stop; retinal diagnosis absent.
findings.proposed_resolution: Reference cobi60/40/20; no re-escalation. Third general AE consider permanent stop; below20 stop. Diagnosed serous retinopathy hold cobi until visual symptoms<=1, ophthalmic review.

findings.source_location: EMA Zelboraf p5§4.4; NCCP directs to SmPC for additional adverse effects
findings.baseline_problem: Grade3–4 hypersensitivity generic rule lacked correct component and separate severe dermatologic permanent-stop exception.
findings.proposed_resolution: Severe vemu HSR or severe dermatologic reaction (SJS/TEN/DRESS) permanently stops vemu; overrides generic first-grade4 choice.

findings.source_location: NCCP tests/supportive care; EMA Zelboraf pp5–6; Cotellic pp7–8
findings.baseline_problem: Monitoring not sufficiently source-specific; duration/treatment breaks could be conflated.
findings.proposed_resolution: Use regimen-specific baseline/during/after tests. Cobi routineLVEF baseline/1month/q3months differs from post-reduced-dose-restart2/4/10/16weeks. Add baseline/monthly CPK/creatinine. Separate response imaging from secondary-malignancy surveillance.

findings.source_location: NCCP00102p2 vs EMA Zelboraf pp5–6§4.4
findings.baseline_problem: NCCP at-risk baseline ECG and week8 thenq12week dermatology differs from current SmPC.
findings.proposed_resolution: Preserve fuller current SmPC all-patient baseline ECG/electrolytes and monthly prescriber skin examination through6months post-treatment; distinguish specialist dermatology visits and record source reconciliation.

findings.source_location: NCCP supportive care; EMA Zelboraf pp9–10§4.6,Tafinlarp14§4.6,Cotellicp10§4.6
findings.baseline_problem: Generic contraception/fertility text risks shortening combination requirement or importing trametinib timing into dabrafenib monotherapy.
findings.proposed_resolution: Dabra alternative effective contraception2weeks, male spermatogenesis may be irreversibly impaired. Vemu effective contraception>=6months/hormonal efficacy may fall. Cobi2methods>=3months, but combination must retain longer vemu requirement. Fertility unknown in humans for these agents; counsel before treatment rather than promise reversibility.

findings.source_location: Current EMA component SmPC§4.5; NCCP drug interaction section
findings.baseline_problem: A generic interaction flag alone does not mean an automatic interaction database has been checked.
findings.proposed_resolution: Require pharmacist medication review; document major CYP/warfarin/digoxin/contraceptive/radiotherapy risks in clinician/patient material. Candidate retains explicit review field; it does not claim exhaustive interaction detection.

00102.schedule: 960mg BID about12h apart continuously; 28-day assessment convention, not a rest week. Until progression/unacceptable toxicity.
00102.food: Preferably food; avoid taking both daily doses fasting; swallow whole.
00102.missed: Take only when at least4h before next; no doubling; no extra dose after vomiting.
anatomical_anchors: Skin: rash/photosensitivity, new skin lesions, severe blistering reaction
Liver/kidneys: blood monitoring and symptoms needing review
Whole body: arthralgia/fatigue; severe allergy emergency
00102.reproductive: Contraception>=6months; hormonal method efficacy may decrease; discuss fertility before therapy, human fertility effect unknown; breastfeeding decision must be made with specialist.

00237.schedule: 150mg BID about12h apart continuously; no planned treatment break.
00237.food: At least1h before or2h after food; swallow capsules whole, do not mix/open/crush.
00237.missed: Skip if less than6h until next dose; do not double.
anatomical_anchors: Whole body: fever/chills, dehydration, low blood pressure;38°C contact/hold safety plan per current EMA
Eyes: uveitis symptoms requiring prompt review
Abdomen: possible pancreatitis; urgent unexplained pain
00237.reproductive: Alternative effective contraception during and2weeks after monotherapy; hormonal contraceptive efficacy reduced. Possible irreversible impaired spermatogenesis; discuss preservation before start. Do not import trametinib16weeks.

00373.schedule: 28-day cycle: cobi60mg OD days1–21, then7days off; vemu960mg BID every day including22–28. Continue until progression/unacceptable toxicity.
00373.food: Cobi with or without food; vemu preferably with food, avoid both daily doses fasting. Swallow whole.
00373.missed: Cobi take only if>=12h before next; vemu>=4h; never double or replace vomited doses.
anatomical_anchors: Heart: LVEF reduction and separate QT rhythm risk
Muscle/kidneys: muscle pain/weakness/dark urine and CPK/rhabdomyolysis
Skin: photosensitivity and phenotype-specific rash/new lesions
Bleeding: unexplained or cerebral warning symptoms
00373.reproductive: Cobi two effective methods>=3months, but vemu>=6months means combined advice must retain longer component requirement; hormonal efficacy interaction review. Human fertility data lacking, discuss preservation; no breastfeeding under NCCP.
00373.source: NCCP00373 pp1–8; EMA Cotellic pp7–10 and Zelboraf pp9–10

00102: EMA Zelborafpp7–9: avoid strong inducers of CYP3A4/P-gp/glucuronidation when possible; caution strong inhibitors.
Narrow-therapeutic-index CYP1A2/CYP3A4 substrates not recommended; warfarin additional INR; digoxin/P-gp substrate levels may need monitoring.
Hormonal contraception may lose efficacy. Radiation recall/sensitisation; do not invent a generic RT washout period. Concurrent ipilimumab not recommended.
00237: EMA Tafinlarpp12–13: CYP2C8/CYP3A4 strong inhibitors increase exposure; consider alternatives/caution; avoid potent inducers incl St Johns wort.

Dabrafenib enzyme induction can lower many medicines and hormonal contraceptive exposure; review anticoagulants/INR, digoxin, steroids, anticonvulsants etc; stopping dabra can reverse induction and increase substrate concentrations.
EMA Tafinlarp11 radiation sensitisation/recall applies to monotherapy too; agree sequencing, no invented interval.
00373: EMA Cotellicpp8–9: avoid strong CYP3A inhibitors; if unavoidable short-term<=7days, consider interrupting cobi (not an automatic20mg dose rule). Moderate inhibitors require caution/monitoring.
Avoid moderate/strong CYP3A inducers; monitor P-gp inhibitor combinations. Apply vemu interactions separately.

validation.baseline_note: The same candidate contract fails on the baseline (including renamed IDs/fields and block-numeric contracts). Do NOT report that failure count as a count of clinical defects. Compare the20 source findings instead.

limits: Source PDF retrieval/checking is not independent human clinical sign-off.
Input omission remains unassessed; no overall treatment clearance.
Interaction review is explicitly manual; this is not an exhaustive medicine interaction engine.
Current source ambiguities/discrepancies are explicit and require clinician/pharmacy resolution.
No browser/render/PDF/patient-suite/full-regression validation performed by this bounded research agent; root must perform integration validation.
Removed generic numerical fields are not reused as normal findings; input/UI migration must be reviewed.
